dashboard.label: Catalyst 9300 MDT Telemetry
dashboard.description: Model-Driven Telemetry dashboard for Catalyst 9300 switching — 48 YANG operational data models via gRPC dial-out to Splunk Metrics Index

search.query: | mstats count WHERE index=cisco_mdt BY host | fields host

| mstats latest(_value) AS value WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*device-hardware*" host="$host$" BY host, software_version, boot_time, last_reboot_reason, serial_number span=5m | stats latest(software_version) AS "SW Version", latest(boot_time) AS "Boot Time", latest(last_reboot_reason) AS "Reboot Reason", latest(serial_number) AS "Serial" BY host | eval Uptime = tostring(now() - strptime('Boot Time', "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "duration") | rename host AS "Switch" | table Switch, "SW Version", Uptime, "Reboot Reason", Serial

| mstats avg(five_seconds) AS "5s", avg(one_minute) AS "1m", avg(five_minutes) AS "5m" WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*cpu-usage*" host="$host$" BY host span=1m | timechart avg("5s") AS "5-Second", avg("1m") AS "1-Minute", avg("5m") AS "5-Minute"
| mstats latest(five_seconds) AS cpu WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*cpu-usage*" host="$host$" BY host span=1m | stats latest(cpu) AS cpu BY host

| mstats latest(used_memory) AS used, latest(free_memory) AS free WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*memory-statistics*" host="$host$" name="Processor" BY host span=1m | eval used_gb = round(used/1073741824, 2), free_gb = round(free/1073741824, 2) | timechart latest(used_gb) AS "Used (GB)", latest(free_gb) AS "Free (GB)"

| mstats latest(memory_stats_used_number) AS used, latest(memory_stats_total) AS total WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*platform-software*" host="$host$" BY host span=5m | stats latest(used) AS used, latest(total) AS total BY host | eval pct = round(used/total*100, 1) | stats avg(pct) AS pct

| mstats latest(holding_memory) AS holding WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*process-memory*" host="$host$" BY name span=5m | stats latest(holding) AS holding BY name | sort -holding | head 10 | eval holding_mb = round(holding/1048576, 2) | fields name, holding_mb
| mstats avg(current_reading) AS reading WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*environment*" host="$host$" sensor_units="celsius" BY name, host span=1m | timechart avg(reading) BY name

| mstats latest(current_reading) AS watts WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*environment*" host="$host$" sensor_name="power*" BY name, location, state, host span=5m | stats latest(watts) AS Watts, latest(state) AS State BY host, name, location | rename host AS Switch, name AS Sensor, location AS Location

| mstats latest(current_reading) AS rpm WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*environment*" host="$host$" sensor_name="fan*" BY name, location, state, host span=5m | stats latest(rpm) AS RPM, latest(state) AS State BY host, name | rename host AS Switch, name AS Sensor

| mstats latest(power_used) AS power WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*poe-oper*" host="$host$" BY intf_name, host span=5m | stats latest(power) AS power_mw BY host, intf_name | where power_mw > 0 | sort -power_mw | head 24 | eval power_w = round(power_mw/1000, 2) | rename host AS Switch, intf_name AS Interface, power_w AS "Power (W)"

| mstats latest(power_used) AS power, latest(oper_power) AS oper WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*poe-oper*" host="$host$" BY intf_name, oper_state, pd_class, host span=5m | stats latest(power) AS "Power (mW)", latest(oper) AS "Oper Power", latest(oper_state) AS Status, latest(pd_class) AS "PD Class" BY host, intf_name | where 'Power (mW)' > 0 | rename host AS Switch, intf_name AS Interface
| mstats count WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*interfaces*" host="$host$" BY name | where NOT match(name, "^(Vlan|Loop|Null|Port-channel)") | fields name | sort name

| mstats avg(statistics_rx_kbps) AS rx, avg(statistics_tx_kbps) AS tx WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*interfaces*" host="$host$" name="$intf_filter$" BY name span=1m | timechart avg(rx) AS "RX Kbps", avg(tx) AS "TX Kbps"

| mstats rate(statistics_in_errors) AS in_err, rate(statistics_out_errors) AS out_err, rate(statistics_in_discards) AS in_disc, rate(statistics_out_discards) AS out_disc WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*interfaces*" host="$host$" name="$intf_filter$" BY name span=1m | timechart sum(in_err) AS "In Errors", sum(out_err) AS "Out Errors", sum(in_disc) AS "In Discards", sum(out_disc) AS "Out Discards"

| mstats latest(statistics_rx_kbps) AS rx, latest(statistics_tx_kbps) AS tx, latest(statistics_num_flaps) AS flaps WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*interfaces*" host="$host$" BY name, oper_status, admin_status, host span=5m | stats latest(rx) AS "RX Kbps", latest(tx) AS "TX Kbps", latest(flaps) AS Flaps, latest(oper_status) AS "Oper", latest(admin_status) AS "Admin" BY host, name | where NOT match(name, "^(Vlan|Loop|Null)") | sort host, name | rename host AS Switch, name AS Interface

| mstats avg(statistics_rx_kbps) AS rx, avg(statistics_tx_kbps) AS tx WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*interfaces*" host="$host$" BY name span=5m | stats avg(rx) AS rx, avg(tx) AS tx BY name | eval total = rx + tx | sort -total | head 10 | fields name, rx, tx

| mstats latest(cost) AS cost WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*stp*" host="$host$" BY instance, if_name, role, state, host span=5m | stats latest(cost) AS Cost, latest(role) AS Role, latest(state) AS State BY host, instance, if_name | sort host, instance, if_name | rename host AS Switch, instance AS "STP Instance", if_name AS Interface
| mstats rate(topology_changes) AS topo_changes WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*stp*" host="$host$" BY instance span=5m | timechart sum(topo_changes) AS "Topology Changes"

| mstats latest(priority) AS priority, latest(latency) AS latency WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*stack*" host="$host$" BY chassis_number, role, node_state, serial_number, host span=5m | stats latest(role) AS Role, latest(node_state) AS State, latest(priority) AS Priority, latest(serial_number) AS Serial, latest(latency) AS "Latency (ms)" BY host, chassis_number | rename host AS Switch, chassis_number AS "#"

| mstats rate(keepalive_counters_sent) AS sent, rate(keepalive_counters_received) AS recv, latest(keepalive_counters_consecutive_losses) AS losses WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*stack*" host="$host$" BY chassis_number span=1m | timechart avg(sent) AS "KA Sent/s", avg(recv) AS "KA Recv/s", max(losses) AS "Consecutive Losses"

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*vlan*" host="$host$" BY id, name, status, host span=5m | stats latest(name) AS "VLAN Name", latest(status) AS Status BY host, id | rename host AS Switch, id AS "VLAN ID" | sort Switch, "VLAN ID"
| mstats dc(mac) AS mac_count WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*matm*" host="$host$" span=5m | stats latest(mac_count) AS mac_count
| mstats dc(address) AS arp_count WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*arp*" host="$host$" span=5m | stats latest(arp_count) AS arp_count

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*lldp*" host="$host$" BY local_interface, device_id, connecting_interface, host span=5m | stats latest(device_id) AS "Neighbor", latest(connecting_interface) AS "Remote Port" BY host, local_interface | rename host AS Switch, local_interface AS "Local Interface"

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*cdp*" host="$host$" BY local_intf_name, device_name, platform_name, port_id, host span=5m | stats latest(device_name) AS "Neighbor", latest(platform_name) AS Platform, latest(port_id) AS "Remote Port" BY host, local_intf_name | rename host AS Switch, local_intf_name AS "Local Interface"

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*components*" host="$host$" BY cname, state_type, state_serial_no, state_status, host span=5m | stats latest(state_type) AS Type, latest(state_serial_no) AS Serial, latest(state_status) AS Status BY host, cname | sort host, cname | rename host AS Switch, cname AS Component

| mstats latest(output_power_instant) AS tx_dbm, latest(input_power_instant) AS rx_dbm, latest(internal_temp) AS temp WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*transceiver*" host="$host$" BY name, host span=5m | stats latest(tx_dbm) AS "TX dBm", latest(rx_dbm) AS "RX dBm", latest(temp) AS "Temp °C" BY host, name | rename host AS Switch, name AS Port

| mstats latest(tcam_entries_used) AS used WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*tcam*" host="$host$" BY name, asic_no, host span=5m | stats latest(used) AS Used BY host, name, asic_no | rename host AS Switch, name AS "Table", asic_no AS ASIC

| mstats latest(max_tcam_percentage_used) AS tcam_pct, latest(max_em_percentage_used) AS em_pct WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*dp-resources*" host="$host$" BY feature, protocol, direction, host span=5m | stats latest(tcam_pct) AS "TCAM %", latest(em_pct) AS "EM %" BY host, feature, protocol, direction | sort -"TCAM %"

| mstats rate(rx_recv_cur) AS punt_rate, rate(rx_dropped_cur) AS drop_rate WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*punt-inject*" host="$host$" BY cpu_punt_queue_name span=1m | timechart sum(punt_rate) AS "Punt Rate", sum(drop_rate) AS "Drop Rate"

| mstats latest(adjacency_table_num_adjacencies) AS total, latest(adjacency_table_num_complete_adjacencies) AS complete, latest(adjacency_table_num_incomplete_adjacencies) AS incomplete WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*fib*" host="$host$" span=5m | stats latest(total) AS Total, latest(complete) AS Complete, latest(incomplete) AS Incomplete

| mstats rate(cef_statistics_ipv4_switching_total_punt) AS punt, rate(cef_statistics_ipv4_switching_total_drop) AS drop WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*fib*" host="$host$" span=1m | timechart avg(punt) AS "IPv4 Punt/s", avg(drop) AS "IPv4 Drop/s"

| mstats latest(prefix_activity_received_current_prefixes) AS rx_pfx, latest(prefix_activity_sent_current_prefixes) AS tx_pfx WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*bgp*" host="$host$" BY neighbor_id, session_state, as, host span=5m | stats latest(session_state) AS State, latest(as) AS "Remote AS", latest(rx_pfx) AS "Prefixes RX", latest(tx_pfx) AS "Prefixes TX" BY host, neighbor_id | rename host AS Switch, neighbor_id AS Neighbor

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*ospf*" host="$host$" BY neighbor_id, state, name, host span=5m | stats latest(state) AS State, latest(name) AS Interface BY host, neighbor_id | rename host AS Switch, neighbor_id AS "Neighbor ID"
| mstats dc(destination_prefix) AS routes WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*routing*" host="$host$" BY source_protocol span=5m | stats latest(routes) AS Routes BY source_protocol

| mstats latest(allocated) AS allocated, latest(available) AS available WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*dhcp*" host="$host$" BY pool_name span=5m | stats latest(allocated) AS Allocated, latest(available) AS Available BY pool_name

| mstats latest(priority) AS priority WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*hsrp*" host="$host$" BY group_id, if_name, state, virtual_ip, active_ip, standby_ip, host span=5m | stats latest(state) AS State, latest(priority) AS Priority, latest(virtual_ip) AS VIP, latest(active_ip) AS "Active IP", latest(standby_ip) AS "Standby IP" BY host, if_name, group_id | rename host AS Switch, if_name AS Interface, group_id AS Group

| mstats latest(priority) AS priority WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*vrrp*" host="$host$" BY if_number, group_id, vrrp_state, virtual_ip, master_ip, host span=5m | stats latest(vrrp_state) AS State, latest(priority) AS Priority, latest(virtual_ip) AS VIP, latest(master_ip) AS "Master IP" BY host, if_number, group_id | rename host AS Switch, if_number AS Interface, group_id AS Group
| mstats avg(offset) AS offset, avg(jitter) AS jitter WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*ntp*" host="$host$" BY assoc_id span=1m | timechart avg(offset) AS "Offset (ms)", avg(jitter) AS "Jitter (ms)"

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*bfd*" host="$host$" BY type, interface, ip, state, host span=5m | stats latest(state) AS State BY host, type, interface, ip | rename host AS Switch, type AS "Session Type", interface AS Interface, ip AS Neighbor

| mstats latest(success_count) AS success, latest(failure_count) AS failure WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*ip-sla*" host="$host$" BY oper_id, oper_type span=1m | timechart latest(success) AS Successes, latest(failure) AS Failures BY oper_id

| mstats latest(flows_added) AS added, latest(flows_aged) AS aged WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*flow-monitor*" host="$host$" BY name span=1m | eval active = added - aged | timechart latest(active) AS "Active Flows" BY name

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*identity*" host="$host$" BY mac, intf_name, state, device_type, vlan_id, host span=5m | stats latest(state) AS State, latest(device_type) AS "Device Type", latest(vlan_id) AS VLAN BY host, intf_name, mac | rename host AS Switch, intf_name AS Interface, mac AS MAC

| mstats rate(match_counter) AS hits WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*access-lists*" host="$host$" BY access_control_list_name, rule_name span=5m | stats avg(hits) AS avg_hits BY access_control_list_name, rule_name | sort -avg_hits | head 10 | eval label = access_control_list_name . " / " . rule_name

| mstats rate(authen_access_accepts) AS accepts, rate(authen_access_rejects) AS rejects WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*aaa*" host="$host$" BY group_name, radius_server_ip span=1m | timechart sum(accepts) AS Accepts, sum(rejects) AS Rejects

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*psecure*" host="$host$" BY if_name, vlan, mac, type, host span=5m | stats latest(type) AS Type BY host, if_name, vlan, mac | rename host AS Switch, if_name AS Interface, vlan AS VLAN, mac AS MAC

| mstats rate(tx_untag_pkts) AS untagged, rate(rx_notag_pkts) AS notag WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*macsec*" host="$host$" BY if_name span=1m | timechart sum(untagged) AS "TX Untagged pkts/s", sum(notag) AS "RX No-Tag pkts/s"
| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*switchport*" host="$host$" BY if_name, admin_mode, host span=5m | stats count BY admin_mode | rename admin_mode AS Mode

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*udld*" host="$host$" BY name, neighbor_state, host span=5m | stats latest(neighbor_state) AS Status BY host, name | rename host AS Switch, name AS Interface

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*lag-aggregate*" host="$host$" BY name, member_link, member_oper_status, host span=5m | stats latest(member_oper_status) AS Status BY host, name, member_link | rename host AS Switch, name AS "Port-Channel", member_link AS Member

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*ha-oper*" host="$host$" BY ha_state, last_switchover_reason, host span=5m | stats latest(ha_state) AS "HA State", latest(last_switchover_reason) AS "Last Switchover" BY host | rename host AS Switch

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*linecard*" host="$host$" BY slot, state, type, host span=5m | stats latest(state) AS State, latest(type) AS Type BY host, slot | rename host AS Switch, slot AS Slot

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*trustsec*" host="$host$" BY sgt, ip, sxp_state, host span=5m | stats latest(sgt) AS SGT, latest(sxp_state) AS "SXP State" BY host, ip | rename host AS Switch, ip AS "Peer IP"

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*vrf-oper*" host="$host$" BY vrf_name, address_family, interface, host span=5m | stats values(interface) AS Interfaces, latest(address_family) AS AF BY host, vrf_name | rename host AS Switch, vrf_name AS VRF

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*install*" host="$host$" BY pkg_name, version, pkg_action, host span=5m | stats latest(version) AS Version, latest(pkg_action) AS State BY host, pkg_name | rename host AS Switch, pkg_name AS Package

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*mdt-oper*" host="$host$" BY subscription_id, tdl_uri, state, host span=5m | stats latest(tdl_uri) AS XPath, latest(state) AS State BY host, subscription_id | sort host, subscription_id | rename host AS Switch, subscription_id AS "Sub ID"

| mstats latest(port_voltage) AS voltage, latest(poe_meta_data_port_shutdown_cnt) AS shutdowns, latest(poe_meta_data_mosfet_fault_cnt) AS mosfet_faults, latest(poe_meta_data_over_tmp_cnt) AS overtemp WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*poe-health*" host="$host$" BY port_num, port_state, host span=5m | stats latest(voltage) AS Voltage, latest(port_state) AS State, latest(shutdowns) AS Shutdowns, latest(mosfet_faults) AS "MOSFET Faults", latest(overtemp) AS "Over-Temp" BY host, port_num | where shutdowns > 0 OR mosfet_faults > 0 OR overtemp > 0 | rename host AS Switch, port_num AS Port

| mstats latest(_value) AS v WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*eigrp*" host="$host$" BY as_num, vrf_name, nbr_address, name, host span=5m | stats latest(name) AS Interface BY host, as_num, vrf_name, nbr_address | rename host AS Switch, as_num AS AS, vrf_name AS VRF, nbr_address AS Neighbor

| mstats latest(holdtime) AS hold WHERE index=cisco_mdt source="*isis*" host="$host$" BY tag, system_id, level, if_name, state, host span=5m | stats latest(state) AS State, latest(hold) AS "Hold (s)" BY host, tag, system_id, level, if_name | rename host AS Switch, tag AS Instance, system_id AS "System ID", if_name AS Interface
